name: delivery_24h
sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,surface_version,strategy_version,state,retrieval_latency_ms FROM recommendation_request WHERE created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND created_at < $2::timestamptz), x AS (SELECT r.*,count(i.id) cards,count(DISTINCT i.target_media_id) distinct_cards,count(i.id) FILTER(WHERE i.candidate_generator='multi-interest-profile') profile_cards FROM r LEFT JOIN recommendation_served_item i ON i.request_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id,r.surface_version,r.strategy_version,r.state,r.retrieval_latency_ms) SELECT surface_version,strategy_version,state,count(*) requests,sum(cards) cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cards=0) zero_card_requests,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cards<>distinct_cards) duplicate_slates,min(cards) minimum_cards,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by cards) median_cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile_cards>0) with_profile_cards,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p95_ms,max(retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_max_ms FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY requests DESC

name: delivery_results_24h
sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,surface_version,result,fallback_reason FROM recommendation_request WHERE created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND created_at<$2::timestamptz), x AS (SELECT r.*,count(i.id) cards FROM r LEFT JOIN recommendation_served_item i ON i.request_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id,r.surface_version,r.result,r.fallback_reason) SELECT surface_version,result,fallback_reason,count(*) requests,sum(cards) cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cards=0) zero_card_requests FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY requests DESC

sql: WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,surface_version,strategy_version,state,retrieval_latency_ms FROM recommendation_request WHERE created_at >= $1::timestamptz AND created_at < $2::timestamptz), x AS (SELECT r.*,count(i.id) cards,count(DISTINCT i.target_media_id) distinct_cards,count(i.id) FILTER(WHERE i.candidate_generator='multi-interest-profile') profile_cards FROM r LEFT JOIN recommendation_served_item i ON i.request_id=r.id GROUP BY r.id,r.surface_version,r.strategy_version,r.state,r.retrieval_latency_ms) SELECT surface_version,strategy_version,state,count(*) requests,sum(cards) cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cards=0) zero_card_requests,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cards<>distinct_cards) duplicate_slates,min(cards) minimum_cards,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by cards) median_cards,count(*) FILTER(WHERE profile_cards>0) with_profile_cards,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p95_ms,max(retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_max_ms FROM x GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY requests DESC

name: request_cohort_minimum_one_hour_followup
sql:
WITH r AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.*,p.execution_mode,p.reason_code personalization_reason
 FROM recommendation_request r LEFT JOIN recommendation_personalization_decision p ON p.request_id=r.id
 WHERE r.created_at >= '2026-09-14T21:30:00Z' AND r.created_at < '2026-09-15T21:30:00Z'
 AND r.expires_at > '2026-09-15T22:35:00Z'
), o AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.episode_id,o.classifier_version) o.* FROM recommendation_outcome_revision o
 JOIN recommendation_playback_episode e ON e.id=o.episode_id JOIN r ON r.id=e.request_id
 WHERE o.created_at < '2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 ORDER BY o.episode_id,o.classifier_version,o.revision DESC
), f AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.surface_version,r.id request_id,r.session_digest,r.created_at,r.locale,r.result,r.fallback_reason,r.seed_media_id,r.execution_mode,r.personalization_reason,
 i.id item_id,i.position,i.target_media_id,i.candidate_generator,i.presentation,
 (rf.id IS NOT NULL) rendered,(im.id IS NOT NULL) impressed,(s.id IS NOT NULL) selected,
 (s.id IS NOT NULL AND im.id IS NOT NULL AND s.occurred_at>=im.occurred_at) selected_after_impression,
 (e.claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND e.claimed_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') claimed,e.id episode_id,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recommendation_playback_fact pf WHERE pf.episode_id=e.id AND pf.kind='playback_start' AND pf.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') started,
 a.id active_outcome,a.qualified_view active_qualified,a.active_playback_milliseconds active_ms,a.active_coverage,a.duration_seconds,a.reasons,
 l.qualified_view legacy_qualified
 FROM r LEFT JOIN recommendation_served_item i ON i.request_id=r.id
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_rendered_fact rf ON rf.item_id=i.id AND rf.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_impression im ON im.item_id=i.id AND im.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_selection s ON s.item_id=i.id AND s.received_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_playback_episode e ON e.selection_id=s.id AND e.created_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z'
 LEFT JOIN o a ON a.episode_id=e.id AND a.classifier_version='active-watch-proxy-v1'
 LEFT JOIN o l ON l.episode_id=e.id AND l.classifier_version='legacy-position-v0'
)
SELECT surface_version,execution_mode,count(distinct request_id) requests,count(distinct session_digest) sessions,
 count(distinct request_id) FILTER(WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL) requests_with_items,
 count(item_id) items,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rendered) rendered,count(*) FILTER(WHERE impressed) impressions,
 count(distinct request_id) FILTER(WHERE impressed) impressed_requests,count(distinct session_digest) FILTER(WHERE impressed) impressed_sessions,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE selected) selections,count(*) FILTER(WHERE selected_after_impression) selections_after_impression,
 count(distinct session_digest) FILTER(WHERE selected) selecting_sessions,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE claimed) claimed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE started) starts,
 count(active_outcome) classified,count(*) FILTER(WHERE active_qualified) active_qualified,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE legacy_qualified) legacy_qualified,
 count(distinct session_digest) FILTER(WHERE active_qualified) qualified_sessions,
 coalesce(sum(active_ms),0) active_ms FROM f GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY requests DESC

name: empty_requests_by_locale_24h
sql: SELECT locale,result,fallback_reason,count(*) requests FROM recommendation_request WHERE created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND created_at<$2::timestamptz AND surface_version='watch-below-player-v1' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 35

name: personalization_decisions_24h
sql: SELECT p.execution_mode,p.reason_code,count(*) requests FROM recommendation_personalization_decision p JOIN recommendation_request r ON r.id=p.request_id WHERE r.created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND r.created_at<$2::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY requests DESC

name: profile_health_1
sql:
WITH interests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT generation_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') live_interests,count(*) FILTER(WHERE kind='durable' AND expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') live_durable,count(*) FILTER(WHERE kind='session' AND expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') live_session FROM recommendation_profile_interest GROUP BY 1), p AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT p.id,p.created_at,p.updated_at,g.id generation_id,g.contribution_count,g.generation,g.input_watermark,g.published_at,g.expires_at generation_expires,i.live_interests,i.live_durable,i.live_session
 FROM recommendation_profile p LEFT JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_pointer ptr ON ptr.profile_id=p.id AND ptr.privacy_generation=p.privacy_generation AND ptr.scope='durable'
 LEFT JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_generation g ON g.id=ptr.generation_id AND g.state='published' AND g.profile_id=p.id AND g.privacy_generation=p.privacy_generation
 LEFT JOIN interests i ON i.generation_id=g.id WHERE p.state='active' AND p.expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' AND p.created_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z')
SELECT count(*) active_profiles,count(*) FILTER(WHERE generation_id IS NULL) no_projection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE generation_id IS NOT NULL AND contribution_count=0) empty_projection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live_interests>0 AND generation_expires>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') usable_profiles,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live_durable>0) durable_profiles,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live_session>0) session_signal_profiles,count(*) FILTER(WHERE contribution_count>0 AND coalesce(live_interests,0)=0) contributed_but_no_live_interest,count(*) FILTER(WHERE generation>1 AND contribution_count>0) populated_with_multiple_generations,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by contribution_count) FILTER(WHERE live_interests>0) populated_median_contributions,percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by contribution_count) FILTER(WHERE live_interests>0) populated_p95_contributions FROM p

name: profile_health_2
sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT g.* FROM recommendation_profile_projection_pointer ptr JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_generation g ON g.id=ptr.generation_id JOIN recommendation_profile p ON p.id=g.profile_id AND p.privacy_generation=g.privacy_generation WHERE p.state='active' AND p.expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' AND g.expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' AND g.contribution_count>0)
SELECT durable_interest_count,session_intent_present,count(*) profiles,min(contribution_count) minimum_contributions,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by contribution_count) median_contributions,max(contribution_count) maximum_contributions FROM g GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

name: profile_health_3
sql:
WITH g AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g.* FROM recommendation_profile_projection_pointer ptr JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_generation g ON g.id=ptr.generation_id JOIN recommendation_profile p ON p.id=g.profile_id AND p.privacy_generation=g.privacy_generation WHERE p.state='active' AND p.expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' AND g.expires_at>'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' AND g.contribution_count>0)
SELECT c.kind,count(*) contributions,count(distinct g.id) profiles,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND o.id IS NULL) missing_outcome,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND o.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT o.qualified_view) unqualified_outcome,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND o.classifier_version<>'active-watch-proxy-v1') wrong_classifier,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND e.state NOT IN ('finalized','timed_out')) unfinished_episode,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND c.target_media_id<>e.media_id) wrong_media,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.kind='qualified_outcome' AND c.privacy_generation<>g.privacy_generation) wrong_privacy_generation,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.expires_at<='2026-09-15T22:30:00Z') expired_contributions FROM g JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_contribution c ON c.generation_id=g.id LEFT JOIN recommendation_outcome_revision o ON o.id=c.source_outcome_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_playback_episode e ON e.id=o.episode_id GROUP BY 1

name: profile_health_4
sql: SELECT g.scope,count(*) personalized_requests,count(distinct g.profile_id) profiles,count(distinct g.id) used_generations,count(*) FILTER(WHERE g.id IS NULL) missing_projection,count(*) FILTER(WHERE g.expires_at<=r.created_at) expired_when_used,count(*) FILTER(WHERE g.published_at>r.created_at) published_after_request,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.interest_count=0) zero_interest_count,percentile_cont(0.5) within group(order by p.profile_retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p50_ms,percentile_cont(0.95) within group(order by p.profile_retrieval_latency_ms) retrieval_p95_ms FROM recommendation_personalization_decision p JOIN recommendation_request r ON r.id=p.request_id LEFT JOIN recommendation_profile_projection_generation g ON g.id=p.projection_generation_id WHERE p.execution_mode='hybrid_personalized' AND r.created_at>='2026-09-14T22:30:00Z' AND r.created_at<'2026-09-15T22:30:00Z' GROUP BY 1
